answer: The best sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New agents join the pool only via staked vouching, like a team roped in a canyon, and earn standing through verified work, so fake identities are never sampled. Flooding the network with cheap accounts gains an attacker nothing; it must age many identities, do real work, and bond stake hard as onyx before a random quorum draw touches one. Each caught cheater forfeits its stake, so this dune costs more than any attack gains.
